scope: local stable uniform-weight evaluation audit; same full-history method, not new stability or error-control guarantees
option: weight_evaluation='direct' (default) or 'stable' on deterministic uniform explicit/implicit solvers

coefficient_matrix.reference: host panel quadrature, with independent 70-digit interval-integral unit checks
coefficient_matrix.metrics: max relative predictor/corrector errors, positivity, future masks

solver_matrix.references_and_diagnostic_tolerances: same as the prior implicit-2026-09-15 protocol

check_policy: require complete unique matrices; stable coefficients meet their stated reference tolerance and masks; solver rows satisfy measurement contracts without demanding global accuracy, positivity, or independent residual <=1
stopping_rule: one full sweep of each matrix per precision; retain all outcomes without changing solver grids, Newton counts or diagnostic tolerances
